caseName: Sevier Commission Co. v. Wallowa National Bank
caseNameFull: Sevier Commission Co. v. Wallowa National Bank
attorneys: Mr. John F. Beilly, with whom Mr. James C. Wilson was on the brief, for petitioners. Mr. Palmer L. Fades, with whom Messrs. Bobert Treat Platt and Harrison O. Platt were on the brief, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The writ of certiorari herein is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question. Wabash Ry. Co. v. Flannigan, 192 U. S. 29; Erie R. Co. v. Solomon, 237 U. S. 427; C. A. King & Co. v. Horton, 276 U. S. 600; Bank of Indianola v. Miller, 276 U. S. 605; Roe v. Kansas, 278 U. S. 191.
